description: List available StatCan cubes (tables) — lean: productId + title (en/fr) + CANSIM id + dimension count + release date. Use the productId with statcan_cube_metadata / statcan_cube_data. StatCan has ~8,000 cubes and its endpoint has no paging of its own, so this tool pages for you: pass `title` to search by name (recommended — it is the fast way to the handful you want), or walk `page`. Default 200 per page; `has_more` tells you whether more exist.

title.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the English and French cube titles, e.g. "egg" or "population". Applied to the cubes scanned on this page.

name: statcan_list_cubes
